title: Density lower bound from lower bounds on balls (parent steps 8–9)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and Λ, c, s ∈ ℝ with s > 0. Let m : ℝ → [0, ∞] and L ∈ [0, ∞]. Put ω := unitBallVolume n, the volume of the open unit ball of ℝⁿ = Euclid n. Assume that ω·ofReal(c)·ofReal(tⁿe^{−Λt}) ≤ m(t) for every t ∈ (0, s), and that m(t)/(ω·ofReal(tⁿ)) → L as t → 0⁺ (along 𝓝[>]0, division in [0, ∞]). Then ofReal(c) ≤ L.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Λ c s : ℝ) (m : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (L : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < s → (∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 s, unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal c * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n * Real.exp (-(Λ * t))) ≤ m t) → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => m t / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 L) → ENNReal.ofReal c ≤ L
